answer: Proof-of-stake identity verification forces agents to bond collateral, effectively curbing the tide of malicious replicas. This mechanism demands that each unique node hold a pearl of cryptographic capital, raising the cost of generating identities to an unsustainable level. Similar to how a nebula coalesces matter to ignite a star, this economic commitment ensures network integrity by making the expense of massive Sybil replication outweigh any potential illicit gain from fraudulent activity.
